svg.text: Litere de tipar (draft v1): print stroke order for planets 1-3 (decision D2)
Top-start print formation as English schools teach it (Little Wandle); Romanian schools prescribe no print stroke order (children write by hand).
Green dot: where a stroke starts; its number is its order. Pink arrow: the direction. A stroke may go back up its own line (m, n, p, d, A, M, N, P, D, E).
Proposed for D2: lower case first to trace; each capital later in the same planet.
